{{Top|leg}}
A '''signblimp''' was a type of floating vehicle bearing light emitters that broadcast advertisements. Signblimps were operated by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and their components included [[flotation cell]]s and a thin [[heglum]] gas envelope. During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|New Republic era]], signblimps operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] bearing ads for a wide variety of services and vices.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
 
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] came under fire on Nar Shaddaa from allies of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare|Zonnos]] and several stray [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts struck a signblimp. Shortly thereafter, Zuma used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to help himself, Irana and Be'ray board another signblimp and escape; the vessel then crashed onto a bridge. Zonnos later captured Irana and a Nar Shaddaa signblimp broadcast a message from the Hutt announcing that the spacer was to be [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="Scourge" />
